positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Customized and maintained Yocto repositories and BitBake recipes for building CIMON HMI and PLC product OS images and software toolchains.
• Designed, implemented, verified, and debugged software written primarily in C/C++, Bash, and Python.
• Created a settings app and a resource management daemon that utilized many Linux-based libraries, such as libevdev, libdbus, libpulse, libnm, etc.
• Coordinated with other teams to add features for an embedded Qt GUI application running customer-designed projects.
• Rewrote a communication daemon connecting remote design software and local HMI apps via gRPC and D-Bus.
• Integrated/patched third-party software for our target platforms, e.g. file server, web browser, VNC server, etc.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on a student team developing firmware for an electric formula race car.
• Developed firmware for communication between car sensors and wireless transceivers to enable live remote telemetry data visualization.
• Used ESP32 and PIC18 microcontrollers with UART, CAN, and ESP-NOW for communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software · C (Programming Language) · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · PIC18 · ESP32 Microcontrollers · Concurrent Programming · Controller Area Network (CAN)

company.name: Formula Racing at UC Davis (FSAE Electric)

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with a team of experienced software engineers to rapidly learn about company software products and the process of applying functional testing to these products in the CI/CD pipeline.
• Wrote tests with Python and Robot Framework to run on AWS EC2 instances.
• Communicated with QA and product team members to create test cases and solve regression issues for products.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Robot Framework · TestRail · Git · BrowserStack · Jenkins · Python (Programming Language) · Selenium

positions.title: Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
• Facilitated conversations about software design decisions and feature ideas.
• Navigated hardware vendors’ Java API documentation to enable a modular implementation of robotic subsystems.
• Communicated within and between teams about expectations to manage project complexity and timeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · OpenCV · Odometry · PID Controller · Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · Vision Processing · Robotics · Kinematics

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed foundations of a software system for automated testing of the company’s product APIs using Postman/JavaScript, Docker, Bitbucket Pipelines, and shell scripts.
• Implemented feedback given by internship mentor to improve design decisions.
• Presented working system to company executives.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Bash · TestRail · Postman API · Git · Python (Programming Language)

company.name: Aperi, A Net Insight IP Product

projects.title: 3D Interactive Scene Renderer
projects.description:
• Developed a web application using custom shaders with WebGL to render hierarchically defined 3D scenes.
• Utilized transformation matrices, quaternions, hierarchical modeling, lighting/shading, and texture mapping.
• Supported user interaction with arcball camera controls and local transformations to the scene hierarchy.
• Used vertex and fragment shaders to implement Gouraud and Phong shading options with Phong reflection.

projects.title: UCD Interact
projects.description:
• Created an application for UC Davis students to optimally schedule courses based on user profile configuration.
• Utilized local relational database to cache and index structured data collected via web scraping.
• Employed technical writing practices in creating a project proposal, a technical description, user personas, a UML use case diagram, and an instruction manual for users.
